details.biography:
Moritz Borman is a German-born film producer who made a name for himself primarily in Hollywood. With a career that spans major studio productions and independent films, Borman has established himself as a versatile and experienced producer. He is known for his collaborations with leading international filmmakers and actors and his involvement in various film projects across different genres. Through his long-standing career and expertise in managing large-scale international projects, Borman has become a respected figure in the film industry.
